scans.label: Show points
scans.tooltip: Show or hide the laser-scan point clouds

scans.label: Colour
scans.tooltip: The colour the scanner captured

scans.label: Intensity
scans.tooltip: Grey by laser return intensity

scans.label: Size
scans.tooltip: Point size on screen (the smallest size when adaptive)

scans.label: Size −
scans.tooltip: Shrink the scan points by 1 px

scans.label: Size +
scans.tooltip: Grow the scan points by 1 px

scans.label: Budget
scans.tooltip: Most points drawn at once over all scans, millions (GPU memory ≈ 16 B per point, plus the cache)

scans.label: Budget −
scans.tooltip: Draw up to 1 million fewer scan points

scans.label: Budget +
scans.tooltip: Draw up to 1 million more scan points

scans.label: Detail
scans.tooltip: How fine the points are loaded. 1 ×: until they sit about one point size apart on screen. Higher loads closer points without moving nearer — 2 × is twice as close, about four times the points — until the budget is full. Raise it when gaps show and the budget is not used up; lower it to load less

scans.label: Detail −
scans.tooltip: Load the scan points coarser (detail factor −0.5)

scans.label: Detail +
scans.tooltip: Load the scan points finer (detail factor +0.5): closer points on screen without moving nearer, as far as the budget allows

scans.label: Max dist
scans.tooltip: Points farther from the camera than this are not streamed or drawn (0 = no limit). The whole budget is then spent within this distance, so what is near gets finer

scans.label: Max dist −
scans.tooltip: Lower the max distance of drawn scan points by 10 m (0 = no limit)

scans.label: Max dist +
scans.tooltip: Raise the max distance of drawn scan points by 10 m

scans.label: Focus
scans.tooltip: Full detail within this distance of the camera; beyond it the detail falls off, so a tight budget goes to what is near first (0 = even detail on screen)

scans.label: Focus −
scans.tooltip: Lower the distance within which scan points get full detail by 5 m (0 = even detail)

scans.label: Focus +
scans.tooltip: Raise the distance within which scan points get full detail by 5 m

scans.label: Cache
scans.tooltip: Points kept in memory beyond the budget, so turning or moving back needs no reload. 0 = keep only what is shown (least memory)

scans.label: Cache −
scans.tooltip: Keep 25 % fewer scan points in memory beyond the budget

scans.label: Cache +
scans.tooltip: Keep 25 % more scan points in memory beyond the budget

scans.label: Budget counts points in view only
scans.tooltip: Large blocks of points that reach outside the view are charged only for the part in view: finer detail on screen, somewhat more memory. Off = every loaded point counts

scans.label: Adaptive size (fill gaps up close)
scans.tooltip: Grow the scan points to their level spacing up close, so no gaps show

scans.label: Only the entered setup’s points
scans.tooltip: Inside a setup, draw only the points that scanner position measured — what its photo actually saw

scans.label: Points drawn
scans.tooltip: In view: what the budget counts — an estimate of the points on screen. Drawn: every point of the blocks in use, the parts outside the picture included (a block is drawn whole); never more than twice the budget

scans.label: Enter
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-door-enter "><path d="M13 12v.01"></path><path d="M3 21h18"></path><path d="M5 21v-16a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h6m4 10.5v7.5"></path><path d="M21 7h-7m3 -3l-3 3l3 3"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Put the camera at the selected scanner setup and show its panorama

scans.label: Exit
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-door-exit "><path d="M13 12v.01"></path><path d="M3 21h18"></path><path d="M5 21v-16a2 2 0 0 1 2 -2h7.5m2.5 10.5v7.5"></path><path d="M14 7h7m-3 -3l3 3l-3 3"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Leave the scanner setup: free camera, panorama hidden

scans.label: Previous setup
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-arrow-left "><path d="M5 12l14 0"></path><path d="M5 12l6 6"></path><path d="M5 12l6 -6"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Select the previous setup of the scan (enters it when a setup is entered)

scans.label: Next setup
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-arrow-right "><path d="M5 12l14 0"></path><path d="M13 18l6 -6"></path><path d="M13 6l6 6"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Select the next setup of the scan (enters it when a setup is entered)

scans.label: Over all
scans.tooltip: Photo covers the model and the points — lower the opacity to see through it

scans.label: Background
scans.tooltip: Photo only where nothing is drawn (hide the points to see it behind the model)

scans.label: Opacity
scans.tooltip: Photo opacity: 100 % shows the photo alone, lower blends it with the model and the points

scans.label: Opacity −
scans.tooltip: Lower the panorama opacity by 10 %

scans.label: Opacity +
scans.tooltip: Raise the panorama opacity by 10 %

scans.label: Show setup markers
scans.tooltip: Show or hide the scanner setup markers in the scene

scans.label: Markers
scans.tooltip: Opacity of the setup marker spheres: lower it when they are in the way (they can still be double-clicked)

scans.label: Markers −
scans.tooltip: Lower the opacity of the setup marker spheres by 10 % (when they are in the way)

scans.label: Markers +
scans.tooltip: Raise the opacity of the setup marker spheres by 10 %

scans.label: Offset step
scans.tooltip: How far one − / + of the X, Y and Z offset boxes below moves a scan, metres. Type a value (0.001 to 1000), or step it: 0.1 → 0.2 … 1 → 2 going up, 0.1 → 0.09 … 0.01 going down

scans.label: Offset step −
scans.tooltip: Make one − / + of the scan offset boxes move less (0.1 → 0.09 … 0.01 m, down to 1 mm)

scans.label: Offset step +
scans.tooltip: Make one − / + of the scan offset boxes move further (0.1 → 0.2 … 1 → 2 m)

scans.label: Open all
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-chevrons-down "><path d="M7 7l5 5l5 -5"></path><path d="M7 13l5 5l5 -5"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Open every scan file

scans.label: Fold all
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-chevrons-up "><path d="M7 11l5 -5l5 5"></path><path d="M7 17l5 -5l5 5"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Fold every scan file away (only the headers stay)

scans.label: Name
scans.tooltip: Click to fold the scan file away or open it. Grey while the scan is switched off.

scans.label: Scan on / off
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-eye "><path d="M10 12a2 2 0 1 0 4 0a2 2 0 0 0 -4 0"></path><path d="M21 12c-2.4 4 -5.4 6 -9 6c-3.6 0 -6.6 -2 -9 -6c2.4 -4 5.4 -6 9 -6c3.6 0 6.6 2 9 6"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: On — click to hide this scan’s points and setup spheres (it stays loaded)

scans.label: Remove scan
scans.icon: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" class="tabler-icon tabler-icon-x "><path d="M18 6l-12 12"></path><path d="M6 6l12 12"></path></svg>
scans.tooltip: Remove this scan from the scene (the asset stays in the library)

scans.label: X
scans.tooltip: Offset along X, metres: moves this scan (points, setups, photos) to line it up with a model. Remembered for this scan

scans.label: X −
scans.tooltip: Move the current scan − one offset step along X (the step is set below the scan list; the offset is remembered for the scan)

scans.label: X +
scans.tooltip: Move the current scan + one offset step along X (the step is set below the scan list; the offset is remembered for the scan)

scans.label: Y
scans.tooltip: Offset along Y, metres: moves this scan (points, setups, photos) to line it up with a model. Remembered for this scan

scans.label: Y −
scans.tooltip: Move the current scan − one offset step along Y (the step is set below the scan list; the offset is remembered for the scan)

scans.label: Y +
scans.tooltip: Move the current scan + one offset step along Y (the step is set below the scan list; the offset is remembered for the scan)

scans.label: Z
scans.tooltip: Offset along Z, metres: moves this scan (points, setups, photos) to line it up with a model. Remembered for this scan

scans.label: Z −
scans.tooltip: Move the current scan − one offset step along Z (the step is set below the scan list; the offset is remembered for the scan)

scans.label: Z +
scans.tooltip: Move the current scan + one offset step along Z (the step is set below the scan list; the offset is remembered for the scan)

scans.label: Points · setups
scans.tooltip: On the right of the name: how many points and setups the scan has. Hover for the exact number.

scans.label: Coords
scans.tooltip: Shown when the scan stores coordinate systems: the one the scan is shown in. Switching is instant and remembered for the scan.

scans.label: Setup row
scans.tooltip: Click selects the setup, double-click enters it. A faint icon means the setup has no photo.
